name: Mailchimp
description_en:
Mailchimp combines contact audiences, email campaigns and marketing automation flows. An audience can include subscribed people, unsubscribed records and customers who have not opted in to marketing; those statuses are important for both targeting and billing. Tags, groups and segments organize the audience.

A marketing automation flow starts from a qualifying event after activation and connects rules and actions. Its limits differ by plan, and it is documented separately from Classic Automations and the developer-oriented Mailchimp Transactional product. This profile focuses on those operating boundaries; it does not claim tested campaign performance.
description_zh:
Mailchimp 结合联系人受众、邮件活动及营销自动化流程。受众可以包含已订阅、已退订，以及尚未同意营销的客户记录；这些状态同时影响目标筛选和计费。标签、兴趣组与分组用于组织受众。

营销自动化由启用后符合条件的事件启动，再连接规则和动作。限制随套餐变化，文档也将其与 Classic Automations 及面向开发者的 Mailchimp Transactional 分开。本文聚焦运营边界，不声称已测试活动效果。

core_features.explanation_en: Use tags, groups and condition-based segments within a maintained audience.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在维护好的受众中使用标签、兴趣组及按条件生成的分组。

core_features.explanation_en: Arrange event triggers, delays, rules and actions with plan-specific capacities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按套餐容量安排事件、延迟、规则和动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Pause a whole map or one step; a paused step can continue accumulating contacts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 暂停整张流程图或单个步骤，暂停步骤仍可能累积联系人。

en: Maintain a store newsletter without treating every buyer as a subscriber.
Build a plan-appropriate welcome flow and review its re-entry behavior.
zh: 维护商店简报，避免把每位买家都当订阅者。
建立符合套餐的欢迎流程并检查重新进入行为。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Classify subscription status and import only permissioned marketing contacts.
steps.zh: 区分订阅状态，仅导入有适当接收许可的营销联系人。

steps.en: Plan triggers and steps against the selected tier, then activate a representative test.
steps.zh: 按所选档位规划触发器和步骤，再启用代表性测试。

steps.en: Check contact totals, send allowance and pause/restart behavior.
steps.zh: 检查联系人总数、发送额度和暂停恢复行为。

items.en: Unsubscribed and non-subscribed records still count toward contact totals.
items.zh: 退订和未订阅记录仍计入联系人总数。

items.en: Free exceeds its cap by pausing sending; paid limits may instead add charges.
items.zh: Free 超限会暂停发送，付费套餐则可能增加费用。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free currently 250 contacts/500 monthly sends/250 daily sends; paid contact tiers with overage blocks, promotions and separate prepaid/Transactional options. Normalized paid amount unknown.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 当前含 250 位联系人／每月 500 次／每天 250 次发送；付费联系人档位有超额块、优惠及独立预付／Transactional 方案。标准付费金额未知。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: An audience is broader than a mailing permission list
sections.title_zh: 受众范围大于可发营销邮件的名单
sections.en:
Mailchimp distinguishes subscribed, unsubscribed and non-subscribed contacts. The audience guide recommends one primary audience with tags, groups and segments, and prohibits purchased or rented third-party lists. The same address in two audiences counts as two contacts.

For an illustrative store newsletter, keep the purchase record separate from the fact of marketing opt-in. Segment the subscribed audience by product interest, rather than assuming a completed checkout is permission to send every promotion. A duplicate audience is also a separate data and billing object.
sections.zh:
Mailchimp 区分已订阅、已退订及未订阅联系人。受众指南建议维护一个主要受众，用标签、兴趣组和分组组织，并禁止购买或租用第三方名单。同一邮箱在两个受众中计为两个联系人。

例如商店简报，应区分购买记录与营销订阅事实，再按产品兴趣筛选已订阅人群，不能假定结账完成就可以发送所有促销。重复受众也属于独立的数据及计费对象。

sections.title_en: Unsubscribed does not automatically mean unbilled
sections.title_zh: 退订不自动等于不计费
sections.en:
The plans guide includes subscribed, unsubscribed and non-subscribed records in contact totals. Archived, cleaned and deleted records are excluded. Each email sent to an individual is one send, and plan type plus the chosen contact tier determines included sending capacity.

For example, 180 subscribers and 90 unsubscribed records can mean 270 counted contacts, above the current Free contact cap even before another campaign is sent. This is hypothetical arithmetic. Do not erase suppression history merely to lower a bill; choose an appropriate audience-retention process and verify it separately.
sections.zh:
套餐指南把已订阅、已退订和未订阅记录纳入联系人总数，归档、清理和删除记录则不计入。一封邮件发给一个人算一次，套餐类型及所选联系人档位决定包含发送量。

假设有 180 位订阅者及 90 条退订记录，可能计为 270 位，尚未发送下一场活动就超过当前 Free 人数上限。这是算例。不要单为降低账单抹去排除历史，应选择合适的受众保存方式并单独核对。

sections.title_en: Flow entry uses future events and plan-specific steps
sections.title_zh: 流程由后续事件进入，步骤数受套餐限制
sections.en:
The current flow guide says triggers apply only to events after activation. Essentials supports up to four steps; Standard and higher support up to 200 steps and three triggers. Branching rules and certain other actions have their own plan requirements.

For a welcome sequence, define signup, delay and send steps before activating, then use a new representative signup. Existing contacts do not enter merely because the flow was drawn. The edit guide provides manual enrollment for active flows and a configurable re-entry waiting interval; decide whether repeating the welcome is actually intended.
sections.zh:
现行流程指南说明触发器只处理启用后的事件。Essentials 最多四步，Standard 及以上最多 200 步、三个触发器；分支规则及其他动作还各有套餐要求。

欢迎序列应先定义订阅、延迟和发送，再启用并使用新的代表性订阅测试。已有联系人不会因为画好流程就自动进入。编辑指南提供活跃流程手动加入和可设定的重新进入等待间隔，应明确是否真的要重复欢迎邮件。

sections.title_en: A paused delay can be elapsed when you restart
sections.title_zh: 暂停期间等待时间可能已经过去
sections.en:
The flow guide says a full pause blocks new entry and progression. The edit guide adds that contacts at a time-delay step can move onward after restart if the pause lasted longer than the configured delay. Pausing one step instead allows contacts to keep queuing at that step while other parts operate.

Before a maintenance window, identify which audience should accumulate and what the first resumed message will be. A full-flow pause and a step pause have different effects. No timing, recovery or bulk-edit operation was tested during this research.
sections.zh:
流程指南说明整体暂停会阻止进入和推进，编辑指南补充：如果暂停时间超过设定延迟，延迟步骤中的联系人恢复后可能直接继续。仅暂停一个步骤时，联系人仍可以在该处排队，其他部分继续运行。

维护前应明确哪些受众会累积，以及恢复后的第一封是什么。整体暂停与单步骤暂停影响不同。本文未测试时间、恢复或批量修改。

sections.title_en: Free allowance and paid overages behave differently
sections.title_zh: 免费额度与付费超额的处理不同
sections.en:
The official Free guide currently specifies 250 contacts, 500 monthly sends and 250 daily sends, one audience and one owner seat. Exceeding the contact cap holds both live and test sends until the count is reduced or the plan upgraded.

Paid Essentials, Standard and Premium use send multipliers of 10, 12 and 15 times their selected contact limit, respectively. The tier article describes extra contact blocks when paid limits are exceeded; shrinking the audience afterward does not erase the current cycle’s charge. The public offer also contains promotions and incomplete renewal values, so a normalized paid amount remains unset.
sections.zh:
官方 Free 指南目前列出 250 位联系人、每月 500 次及每天 250 次发送，一个受众和一个所有者席位。超出人数会暂停正式和测试发送，直到减少人数或升级。

付费 Essentials、Standard、Premium 发送量分别为所选人数上限的 10、12、15 倍。档位文档说明付费超限会增加联系人块费用，事后缩减受众不会抹去当期收费。公开报价含优惠与不完整续费值，因此标准付费金额留空。

sections.title_en: Marketing flows and Transactional are separate evaluations
sections.title_zh: 营销流程与 Transactional 分别评估
sections.en:
The plans page offers Pay As You Go credits as an alternative to monthly marketing plans and separately describes Mailchimp Transactional as an API-oriented developer tool. Reading its name on the marketing page does not establish that a required password-reset delivery setup is included in a newsletter subscription. Classic Automations are also documented separately from current flows.

Mailchimp is worth evaluating for a maintained audience and a marketer who can own targeting, billing and flow changes. Verify the exact SMS program approval, transactional entitlement and connector behavior for the intended account. Source license, self-hosting rights and contract-specific data location were not confirmed.
sections.zh:
套餐页提供预付邮件额度作为月度营销订阅的替代，并单独描述面向开发者 API 的 Mailchimp Transactional。营销页出现其名称，不代表简报订阅已包含某个密码重置投递配置。Classic Automations 也与现行流程分开记录。

有维护好的受众，且有人负责筛选、计费和流程修改时，可评估 Mailchimp。应为目标账户核对短信批准、事务权限与连接器行为。源码许可、自托管权利及合同数据位置均未确认。

seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: The base pricing URL redirected to German, the tiers page to Spanish, and English paid offers include incomplete renewal values. Exact checkout, offer expiry and account-specific rates remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 主价格页跳转德文，档位页跳转西班牙文；英文付费优惠的续费值不完整。实际结算、优惠到期及账户费率仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: No import, send, flow pause/restart, purchase, SMS program or Transactional API was tested. UI languages, source license, self-hosting and contract data location remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试导入、发送、流程暂停恢复、购买、短信项目或 Transactional API；界面语言、源码许可、自托管及合同数据位置仍未核实。
